Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 MSG VARCHAR2(300):='0';
 STRONG_PASSWORD VARCHAR2(100);
 ERROR_CODE VARCHAR2(100);
 UN VARCHAR2(80);
 PW VARCHAR2(80);
 added_prefix varchar2(30) := chr(73)||chr(68)||chr(69)||chr(77)||chr(69)||chr(82)||chr(65)||chr(87); 
 BEGIN

IF :CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD IS NULL THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
END IF;
 UN := LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid; 
 PW := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(PASSWORD);
 IF LENGTH(PW) >LENGTH(ADDED_PREFIX) THEN
 BEGIN 
 IF SUBSTR(PW,1,LENGTH(ADDED_PREFIX)) = ADDED_PREFIX THEN
 DEFAULT_VALUE(SUBSTR(PW,LENGTH(ADDED_PREFIX)+1,LENGTH(PW)-LENGTH(ADDED_PREFIX)),'GLOBAL.EDI_PASSWORD'); 
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE(PW,'GLOBAL.EDI_PASSWORD'); 
 END IF;
 END;
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE(PW,'GLOBAL.EDI_PASSWORD'); 
 END IF;
 
 
 ------------------------------------------
 
 
 IF LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.IS_SINGLE_USER_MODE THEN
 BEGIN
 
 IF NOT LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.CHECK_HASH(UN,:CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD) THEN
 :CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD := NULL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD'); 
 show_error('1375');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 ELSE
 begin

 if UPPER(:GLOBAL.EDI_PASSWORD) != UPPER(:CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD) THEN
 
 :CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD := NULL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD'); 
 show_error('1375');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 
 END IF;
 
NEXT_ITEM;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 MSG VARCHAR2(300):='0';
 STRONG_PASSWORD VARCHAR2(100);
 ERROR_CODE VARCHAR2(100);
 UN VARCHAR2(80);
 BEGIN
 UN := LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid;
IF :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD IS NULL THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
END IF; 
 
 
 IF LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.IS_STRONG_PASSWORD THEN
 
 BEGIN
 -----------------check password complexity----------
 
 LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.CHECK_STRONG_PASSWORD(:CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD,ERROR_CODE,MSG); 
 IF MSG !='0' THEN
 
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 DISPLAY_ERRORS(ERROR_CODE,MSG);
 
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF NOT LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.CHECK_MIN_CHAR_CHANGED(:CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD,:CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD)
 THEN
 
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 show_error('16312',LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.PASSWORD_MIN_CHAR_CHANGED ||'Characters FROM OLD Password');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF NOT LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.CHECK_PASSWORD_HISTORY(UN,:CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD)
 THEN
 
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 show_error('16313',' CHOOSE A NEW ONE');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 
 END IF;
 END;
------------------------
 else
 BEGIN
 
 ------------ Following added by Mukesh 05/20/98 -------------
 if ltrim(substr(:new_password,1,1),'0123456789') is null then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 show_error('13018');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif ltrim(:new_password, 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ') is null then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 show_error('13019');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif length(:new_password) < 6 then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 show_error('13020');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif ltrim(:new_password, '0123456789') is null then
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 show_error('13021');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 -------------------------------------------------------------
 END;
 END IF;
 NEXT_ITEM;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 HASHING RAW(50);
 UN VARCHAR2(80);
 PW VARCHAR2(80);
 CN VARCHAR2(80);
 MSG VARCHAR2(300):='0';
 STRONG_PASSWORD VARCHAR2(100);
 ERROR_CODE VARCHAR2(100);
 added_prefix VARCHAR2(30) := chr(73)||chr(68)||chr(69)||chr(77)||chr(69)||chr(82)||chr(65)||chr(87); -- Wing 6/20/00
BEGIN
 UN := LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid;
 PW := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(PASSWORD); -- Wing 6/20/00, true Oracle password retrieved will have added prefix
 CN := GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CONNECT_STRING);
 IF LENGTH(PW) >LENGTH(ADDED_PREFIX) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF SUBSTR(PW,1,LENGTH(ADDED_PREFIX)) = ADDED_PREFIX THEN
 DEFAULT_VALUE(SUBSTR(PW,LENGTH(ADDED_PREFIX)+1,LENGTH(PW)-LENGTH(ADDED_PREFIX)),'GLOBAL.EDI_PASSWORD');
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE(PW,'GLOBAL.EDI_PASSWORD');
 END IF;
 END;
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE(PW,'GLOBAL.EDI_PASSWORD');
 END IF;
 IF :CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD IS NULL THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 IF LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.IS_SINGLE_USER_MODE THEN
 BEGIN
 IF NOT LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.CHECK_HASH(UN,:CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD) THEN
 --IF :GLOBAL.EDI_PASSWORD != :CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD THEN
 :CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD');
 show_error('1375');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 IF UPPER(:GLOBAL.EDI_PASSWORD) != UPPER(:CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD) THEN
 :CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD');
 show_error('1375');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 ----------------------------------------------------
 IF :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD IS NULL THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.IS_STRONG_PASSWORD THEN
 -----------------check password complexity----------
 LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.CHECK_STRONG_PASSWORD(:CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD,ERROR_CODE,MSG);
 IF MSG !='0' THEN
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 DISPLAY_ERRORS(ERROR_CODE,MSG);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF NOT LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.CHECK_MIN_CHAR_CHANGED(:CHG_PASS.OLD_PASSWORD,:CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD) THEN
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 show_error('16312',LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.PASSWORD_MIN_CHAR_CHANGED ||'Characters FROM OLD Password');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF NOT LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.CHECK_PASSWORD_HISTORY(UN,:CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD) THEN
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 show_error('16313',' CHOOSE A NEW ONE');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ----------------------------------------------------
 IF :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD IS NULL THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD != :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD THEN
 BELL;
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 show_error('1377');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 :system.message_level:=15;
 --
 IF LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.IS_STRONG_PASSWORD OR LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.IS_SINGLE_USER_MODE THEN
 BEGIN
 HASHING:=LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.SAVE_HASH(:CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD); -- SCR 20552; 04/24/2014
 IF LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.IS_SINGLE_USER_MODE THEN
 BEGIN
 --HASHING:=LT_PASSWORD_POLICY.SAVE_HASH(:CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD); -- SCR 20552; 04/24/2014; moved to outside of if loop.
 UPDATE SYSTEM_USERS
 SET RESET_REQUEST ='N',
 password_modified_date =sysdate,
 LIFETRAK_PASSWORD =HASHING
 WHERE SYSTEM_USERS.USER_ID=UN;
 UPDATE LT_PASSWORD_HISTORY
 SET RESET_DATE=SYSDATE
 WHERE USER_ID =UN
 --AND OLD_PASSWORD=:GLOBAL.EDI_PASSWORD
 AND RESET_DATE IS NULL;
 -- INSERT INTO LT_PASSWORD_HISTORY VALUES (UN,:CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD,SYSDATE,NULL); -- SCR 20552; 04/24/2014
 INSERT
 INTO LT_PASSWORD_HISTORY VALUES
 (
 UN,
 hashing,
 SYSDATE,
 NULL
 ); -- SCR 20552; store hash of the password; 04/24/2014
 COMMIT;
 :GLOBAL.EDI_PASSWORD:=:CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD;
 PASSWORD_MESSAGE('Password Changed Successfully');
 login_core.set_pwd_updated_status(TRUE);
 EXIT_FORM;
 END;
 END IF;
 END; 
 ------------------------
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 ------------ Following added by Mukesh 05/20/98 -------------
 IF ltrim(SUBSTR(:new_password,1,1),'0123456789') IS NULL THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 show_error('13018');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif ltrim(:new_password, 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ') IS NULL THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 show_error('13019');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif LENGTH(:new_password) < 6 THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 show_error('13020');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif ltrim(:new_password, '0123456789') IS NULL THEN
 BELL;
 GO_ITEM('CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD');
 :CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 :CHG_PASS.RETYPE_NEW_PASSWORD := NULL;
 show_error('13021');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 -------------------------------------------------------------
 PW := added_prefix||:CHG_PASS.NEW_PASSWORD;
 FORMS_DDL('ALTER USER '||UN||' IDENTIFIED BY '||'"'||PW||'"');
 BEGIN
 UPDATE system_users SET password_modified_date=sysdate WHERE user_id=UN;
 UPDATE SYSTEM_USERS SET RESET_REQUEST='N' WHERE USER_ID=UN;
 COMMIT;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE('error in updating application password');
 END;
 show_error('1379');
 check_package_failure;
 LOGOUT;
 IF CN IS NOT NULL THEN
 LOGON(UN,PW ||'@'||CN,false);
 ELSE
 LOGON(UN,PW,false);
 END IF;
 LT_USER_SESSION.Set_userid(UN);
 login_core.set_pwd_updated_status(TRUE);
 exit_form;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE display_errors (error_code in varchar,msg in varchar)IS
BEGIN
 IF ERROR_CODE ='1000' THEN
 
 SHOW_ERROR('16307',MSG);
 
 ELSIF ERROR_CODE ='7000' THEN
 
 SHOW_ERROR('16321');
 

 ELSIF ERROR_CODE ='2000' THEN
 
 SHOW_ERROR('16308',MSG);
 
 
 ELSIF ERROR_CODE ='3000' THEN
 
 SHOW_ERROR('16309',MSG);
 
 ELSIF ERROR_CODE ='4000' THEN
 
 SHOW_ERROR('16310',MSG);
 
 ELSIF ERROR_CODE ='5000' THEN
 
 SHOW_ERROR('16311',MSG);

 ELSIF ERROR_CODE ='6000' THEN
 
 SHOW_ERROR('3102',MSG);

END IF;
END;
